blocks.text: On confirmed contamination, the Recall Lead immediately quarantines affected inventory and Regulatory Affairs notifies the regulator in parallel.
Quality records lot numbers, photographs, and chain-of-custody evidence before any product is destroyed.
If distribution has begun, Customer Operations sends the customer recall notice within four hours of confirmation.
